detail.description:
Ready for a Woolly Adventure?
Jump into a new casual 3D puzzle! There’s cute yarn, a mischievous dragon, and exciting rescues!
A colorful, naughty dragon is causing trouble, and a kitty needs your help! Solve the puzzle, clear the path, and become the ultimate Dragon Slayer!

How to be a Dragon Slayer:
Pick Your Cannon: Tap the right color! Show that dragon who’s boss!
Target the Dragon: Blast away the matching colored blocks to slow it down.
Save the Kitty: Repel the dragon and keep the cat saf
detail.releaseNotes: New enhanced features added! Experience the upgraded peripherals now!
